sourceFile: 53. TIU C11-20 Report  find reason function high 2026.02.3_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable rows but invalidly conflates distinct tests and uses at least one wrong normal comparator.
issues: Changed factor merges unrelated test types, lines, dates, positions, and process changes.
VP date 1/2 test is compared to a normal row from a different section instead of its local normal row.
Machine/line values are treated as changed conditions without proof they are the causal factor.
Measurement outcome is a parsed defect-count table, not a true measurement study.
Subgroup keys and evidence rows include uncited or unclear rows not shown in context.
correctionPlan: Split changed factors by report section/test condition: holder-position YOKE, VP date 1/2, drying-time increase, clean/remake.
For each test, pair only with the adjacent/local Normal row in the same table and preserve date, line, and section keys.
Recompute NG rate deltas using the correct paired rows, including Test!42 versus Test!44.
Remove the measurement outcome unless actual measurement/spec rows exist.
Limit evidence to title/purpose/content rows plus each table header and paired test/normal result rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but grouping and comparator citations are insufficient for final evidence.
